title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1971-12-31
source: Source: KSAN > FM Master reel > cassette > pcm ( Sony ESX HiFil-750) - Provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: pcm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > Celemony Capstan > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick

ai_review.summary: Excellent FM broadcast source with perfect speed/pitch and crystal‑clear transfer, though the musical content isn’t described
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this new transfer – noting the flawless speed and pitch that avoids the common slowed‑down plague of many older releases. The recording is praised as an “amazing copy” with superb clarity, but no specific comments are made about the performance itself.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews focus on outstanding recording quality; lack of musical commentary keeps the overall rating slightly below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch and speed are spot‑on, no slowdown artifacts; transfer is clear and lively, praised as a relief from slowed‑down sources.
